summary: OS Therapies Inc filed a Form 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting that effective September 29, 2026, its board appointed Francis (Frank) Knuettel II as Chief Financial Officer and Kerry Clem as Chief Commercial Officer. Concurrently, Christopher P. Acevedo ceased serving as CFO but will remain in a consulting capacity. Item 1.01 incorporates the agreement under Item 5.02. No financial terms, compensation details, or advisor were disclosed regarding these appointments. The abrupt CFO transition and addition of a Chief Commercial Officer signals shifting leadership focus. Watch for subsequent filings detailing compensatory arrangements and any strategic implications.
